lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਓ ਕਲ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee karanaa keeo kal aape hee tai dhaareeai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhahi keetaa aapanaa dhar kachee pakee saareeai ||
lines.translation: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo aaiaa so chalasee sabh koee aaee vaareeai ||
lines.translation: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke jee paraan hahi kiu saahib manahu visaareeai ||
lines.translation: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: aapan hathee aapanaa aape hee kaaj savaareeai ||20||
lines.translation: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh kinehee aasakee doojai lagai jaai ||
lines.translation: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aasak kaa(n)dheeai sad hee rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa kar ma(n)ne ma(n)dai ma(n)daa hoi ||
lines.translation: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when things go badly

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aasak ehu na aakheeai j lekhai varatai soi ||1||
lines.translation: - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲਾਮੁ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: salaam jabaab dovai kare mu(n)dhahu ghuthaa jaai ||
lines.translation: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gone wrong from the very beginning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dovai kooReeaa thaai na kaaee paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit seviai sukh paaeeai so saahib sadaa samhaaleeai ||
lines.translation: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਘਾਲ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit keetaa paaeeai aapanaa saa ghaal buree kiu ghaaleeai ||
lines.translation: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa mool na keechaee de la(n)mee nadar nihaaleeai ||
lines.translation: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤੇਵੇਹਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu saahib naal na haareeai tevehaa paasaa dhaaleeai ||
lines.translation: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: kichh laahe upar ghaaleeai ||21||
lines.translation: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree naale gaarab vaad ||
lines.translation: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: galaa kare ghanereeaa khasam na paae saad ||
lines.translation: he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaai sevaa kare taa kichh paae maan ||
lines.translation: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and then performs service, he shall be honored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਗਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so paravaan ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਵਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jeei hoi s ugavai muh kaa kahiaa vaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: beeje bikh ma(n)gai a(n)mrit vekhahu ehu niaau ||2||
lines.translation: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice is this? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naal iaane dosatee kade na aavai raas ||
lines.translation: Friendship with a fool never works out right.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
lines.translation: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vasatoo a(n)dar vasat samaavai doojee hovai paas ||
lines.translation: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib setee hukam na chalai kahee banai aradaas ||
lines.translation: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kamaanai kooRo hovai naanak siphat vigaas ||3||
lines.translation: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵਡਾਰੂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naal iaane dosatee vadaaroo siu nehu ||
lines.translation: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: paanee a(n)dar leek jiu tis daa thaau na thehu ||4||
lines.translation: are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ਕਰੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਆਣਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi iaanaa kare ka(n)m aan na sakai raas ||
lines.translation: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਅਧ ਚੰਗੀ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਭੀ ਵੇਰਾਸਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: je ik adh cha(n)gee kare doojee bhee veraas ||5||
lines.translation: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree je chalai khasamai bhaai ||
lines.translation: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: huramat tis no agalee ohu vajahu bh doonaa khaai ||
lines.translation: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗੈਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasamai kare baraabaree phir gairat a(n)dar paai ||
lines.translation: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਗਲਾ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vajahu gavaae agalaa muhe muhi paanaa khaai ||
lines.translation: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis daa ditaa khaavanaa tis kaheeai saabaas ||
lines.translation: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮ ਚਲੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na chalaee naal khasam chalai aradaas ||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh kinehee daat aapas te jo paaeeai ||
lines.translation: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking?
